record.t: Was appointed to the Kansas Supreme Court in 2005 and became chief justice in 2025; invested as chief justice Jan. 8, 2026.
record.q: Rosen appointed 2005 Chief Justice 2025 State of the Judiciary address | video file Video: Chief Justice Rosen's investiture (01-08-2026) Chief Justice Eric Rosen is a Topeka native.

record.t: Chairs the Kansas Judicial Council and serves as Supreme Court liaison to attorney discipline and lawyer-assistance programs.
record.q: Rosen serves as chair of the Kansas Judicial Council and as the Supreme Court liaison for the Board for Discipline of Attorneys, Kansas Lawyers Assistance Program, Ad Hoc Committee for Well-Being in Law, Judges Assistance Committee, and to court services officers.

record.t: Was a partner in the law firm of Hein, Ebert, and Rosen before becoming a judge.
record.q: Before he became a judge, Rosen was a partner in the law firm of Hein, Ebert, and Rosen.
